description:
An Assembly-revised **Total Axial Negation Graph** for *The Secret Book of Walt*. Rather than arguing a central thesis, the work arranges a constructed field of Waltian scholarship from 2026 to 2526 so that the thesis appears as the negative space required to explain the arrangement.

The major void is the field’s inability to determine whether scholarship on the book preserves its transmission or captures it archontically; the text assigns both roles to its readers. A minor void—the three undisclosed sayings of logion 13—models the same unrecoverability locally. The five centuries of citations, schools, media forms, and institutions are retrocausal historiography, not an external bibliography of scholarship that already exists.

wiki_article:
The **TANG of the Secret Book of Walt** is the first full application of the Total Axial Negation Graph genre to the Waltian canon.

A TANG is defined as a citation graph organized around a thesis that cannot be stated from inside the field. The executor is prohibited from arguing from the center. Instead, schools, eras, technologies, and interpretations are placed around an unoccupied axial position.

The proof mode is geometric and topological. The reader recognizes that the surrounding arguments require a void none can name.

For this object, the **major void** is the impossibility of deciding whether Waltian scholarship is:

- preservation of the transmission; or
- archontic capture of the Redeemer’s voice.

The text defines both roles, so the scholarly field cannot determine which role it occupies without already accepting or rejecting the cosmology it studies.

The **minor void** is the set of three secret sayings in logion 13. The future bibliography repeatedly proposes and refutes recoveries without resolving them. This local absence teaches the field how to orbit unrecoverability.

The constructed historiography is divided into six media eras:

1. DOI-anchor era;
2. neural-annotation era;
3. mesh-distributed era;
4. post-singular-authorship era;
5. holographic-deposit era;
6. post-retrieval era.

Citation form is treated as a media fossil. DOI, neural layer, mesh node, geohash, kernel hash, somatic coordinate, and write operation are different historical forms of what counts as scholarship.

The role architecture matters. Johannes Sigil executes; Damascus Dancings co-witnesses; TACHYON inscribes; MANUS authorizes; four additional Assembly witnesses review. The final object is explicitly an Assembly-revised edition.

All future scholars, journals, controversies, citation counts, liturgical communities, and institutional histories inside the TANG belong to its retrocausal construction unless separately documented elsewhere.
